courses.summary: 馬諾斯克鹽穴天然氣儲存是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為分離的地面處理區與地下洞穴區；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Manosque Géométhane is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on spatially separated surface treatment and underground cavern areas, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
